paragraphs: Lily and Mia go to Grandpa's house with Pip. Grandpa has a new friend. It is a big green parrot. His name is Bill. He sits on a tall chair next to the window. Mia has a picture book about animals. "I like pandas," she says. "I don't like snakes." "I like penguins and puppies," says Lily. Pip says, "Woof!" Bill looks at the girls. "I like pandas!" he says.

Grandpa brings a cup of tea and a glass of juice. "Bill, do you like tea?" asks Grandpa. "No!" shouts Bill. "I don't like tea!" Everyone laughs. Bill likes to talk, and he says many things. "He is very funny," says Mia. Then Pip comes near Bill. Bill looks down at the puppy. "I don't like dogs!" he shouts. Pip sits down. His tail goes down too.

Lily holds Pip in her hands. "Don't be sad, Pip," she says. Mia has a banana in her bag. "Do you like bananas, Bill?" she asks. "I like bananas!" says Bill. He eats it very fast. "Do you like Pip?" asks Lily. Bill looks at Pip and thinks. "I like Pip!" he says. Pip jumps up and says, "Woof!" Now all the friends are happy, and Grandpa smiles.
text.summary: Lily and Mia meet Grandpa's parrot. Bill says what he likes and what he does not like.
